Subject: Supplier portal activation failing - invite link keeps bouncing

Hi Lauren,

We tried accepting the supplier invite you sent yesterday (Coupa link) but every time one of our users clicks Accept the page immediately redirects to a bot-check/captcha and then returns a 400. The UI shows a tiny hidden field and then the form refuses to submit

Steps we took:
- Clicked invite link in Chrome (desktop) -> redirect to /check?code=honeypot
- Tried incognito -> same result
- Tried mobile -> same flow

I grabbed a screenshot and attached (invite-screenshot.png). We also see a short request id in the dev console: req=7f3a2c. Can you confirm if there are any known anti-bot measures on your supplier form? This is blocking our PO setup — our AP team needs the vendor profile created today to invoice.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Supplier portal activation failing - invite link keeps bouncing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the detailed steps and the screenshot.

Sorry you're seeing this — that req id is helpful. Two quick asks while we investigate:
1) Can you forward the full browser network log (HAR) if convenient, or the console request headers?
2) Could you confirm the email address you're clicking from (sometimes corporate forwarders rewrite headers and trigger filters)?

Initial hypothesis: our onboarding form includes a hidden "honeypot" field (meant to trap bots). Some vendor portals (especially when we proxy invites through certain CDNs) mis-handle that hidden field and our server treats the request as suspicious, returning a bot-check page which then causes the 400 on the accept endpoint.

Workaround I can run right away: we can resend the invite using an alternate acceptance endpoint that skips the honeypot check for a short window and whitelist BrightSupply's domain for this invite. Ben, can you confirm we have an admin bypass token we can use for this vendor?

Alyssa — if you have a moment now I can trigger the resend and share a temporary one-time link. Otherwise we'll schedule a quick test with your AP team this afternoon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Partner Onboarding | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: none

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-14T09:51:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier portal activation failing - invite link keeps bouncing (internal)

Lauren — noted. This matches a rate/entropy heuristic we rolled out last quarter. Details:
- Honeypot field name: hp_email_ts (hidden input). If present but empty, backend marks as automated and redirects to /bot-challenge.
- Trace for req=7f3a2c shows: 200 -> redirect /bot-challenge -> 400 due to missing challenge cookie.

Short-term options:
- Generate a one-time acceptance URL that uses invite-accept-v2 which bypasses hp check for the token's lifetime (we can set 12h TTL). This is quick and low-risk.
- Add BrightSupply domain to the invite-skiplist (requires a config change; ops runway ~30 min and needs audit log entry).

I attached trace-logs-20270714.txt (sanitized) with the request/response headers and the internal trace-id: trace-20270714-3a2c. If we go with the one-time URL I can generate it now. Marcus — please prep an audit log entry and a short note for compliance if we whitelist.

-Ben

If you prefer not to click a temporary link, we can also walk your AP team through a screen-share while we accept on their behalf.

Thanks for the quick report — we'll follow up after you confirm the invite works so we can remove the skiplist and record the change request properly.
